decisions.summary: Add/edit form moved into a <dialog> slide-over (right on desktop, bottom sheet on mobile); entry cards replaced by a hairline-ruled list with quiet row actions; transient confirmations moved to a toast stack while save/clipboard failures stay as inline alerts.
decisions.constraints: Existing tokens only (paper/ink/mint/primary), Noto Serif, zero radius, 2px ink borders and block shadows, Material Symbols, 44px touch targets, prefers-reduced-motion honored. No new runtime dependencies.

decisions.summary: ⌘K / Ctrl+K palette mounted once for any unlocked session: credentials (↵ copies the password, ⌘↵ opens it for editing) plus navigation, add-credential and lock-vault actions. Combobox + listbox semantics with aria-activedescendant; native <dialog> for the focus trap and Esc. A ⌘K keycap hint sits in the vault search field at md and up only — the inline field stays the primary path on touch.

Posture sentence under the vault heading (count · reuse · breaches · audit-chain state, the last two linking to their pages), deliberately a sentence rather than the banned hero-metric tile row. Per-row segmented strength meters plus a quiet REUSED badge; the sheet's password field shows the meter with ≈bits, or names the common-word pattern when the entropy estimate would overstate it. Audit-chain clause only renders once verifyAuditLog succeeds.
